subject.title: fix(security): close active April 4 transport and auth gaps

question: Should PR #60488 be rebased as one security branch or split into smaller current-main repairs before maintainers reconsider merge?
rationale: The remaining blockers mix security policy, Discord message-delivery semantics, and stale current-main owner paths, so automation should not choose the permanent policy or merge shape alone.

options.title: Rebase Into Current Owner Paths
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main and repair the proxy, auth, Discord, and changelog conflicts before maintainers consider merge.

options.title: Split The Security Work
options.body: Replace the stale branch with smaller PRs for DNS-aware proxy hardening, shared-auth rotation, and approved Discord mention behavior if rebasing stays tangled.

options.title: Close If Superseded
options.body: Close this PR only if maintainers decide current main already covers the desired auth/proxy hardening and the Discord policy change is not planned.

recommendation.title: Rebase Into Current Owner Paths
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main and repair the proxy, auth, Discord, and changelog conflicts before maintainers consider merge.
